info.title: API.SH: JustWatch
info.description: The JustWatch API from API.SH: public JustWatch data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Films and seasons about to leave a streaming service in a country, with the leaving date, the service and offer, and the title details (year, genres, runtime, scores, poster, link). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justwatch-leaving

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country (default US): offers and titles of that country.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Only these services: comma-separated short codes, e.g. `nfx` (Netflix).

parameters.name: within
parameters.description: Leaving today, tomorrow, within 7 days or within 30 days (default).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of titles, descriptions and genre names (default en).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only films or only series.

parameters.name: monetization
parameters.description: Comma-separated: FLATRATE, FREE, ADS, RENT, BUY, CINEMA, FLATRATE_AND_BUY, FAST.

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated genre codes, e.g. act, cmy, drm, hrr, scf.

parameters.name: year_min
parameters.description: Released in or after this year.

parameters.name: year_max
parameters.description: Released in or before this year.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Titles per page (default 20, max 40).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search films and series and see where each streams in a country. Each title: id, type, title, original title, link, year, release date, description, runtime, age rating, production countries, genres, IMDb and TMDB ids and scores, IMDb votes, JustWatch rating, Tomatometer, likes and dislikes, poster, upcoming releases, and its offers in that country. Each offer: service (name, id, short code, icon), monetization type (subscription, free, ads, rent, buy), quality (SD, HD, 4K), price and currency, previous price and change, link, episode count, available-until date, date added, audio and subtitle languages and video/audio technology. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justwatch-search

get.description:
One film, series or season by JustWatch id or link, with every offer in up to 20 countries: id, type, title, original title, link, year, release date, description, runtime, age rating, production countries, genres, IMDb and TMDB ids and scores, IMDb votes, JustWatch rating, Tomatometer, likes and dislikes, poster, upcoming releases, backdrops, trailers, cast and crew, seasons (series), `streaming_chart` (films and series: the title's JustWatch daily streaming chart position in the first country, with trend, best rank and days in the top 3, 10 and 100; null when not charted), and `offers` per country. Each offer: service (name, id, short code, icon), monetization type (subscription, free, ads, rent, buy), quality (SD, HD, 4K), price and currency, previous price and change, link, episode count, available-until date, date added, audio and subtitle languages and video/audio technology.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justwatch-title

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: JustWatch id: tm… film, ts… series, tss… season, e.g. `tm414170` (Parasite).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Or a justwatch.com title link (its country is the default country).

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated two-letter countries to list offers for (default US, max 20).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of titles, descriptions and genre names (default en), e.g. de, es, fr.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
